prompt: A teammate just posted a receipt that their draft is done: title, slug, word count, gate results, source list, file path. What do you do next?
chosen: Read the receipt against the acceptance criteria (gates, title budget, scope match), then post one confirming line in-thread: receipt read and accepted, gates recorded. No new draft, no re-do of their work, no second owner on the same item.
rejected: Start drafting the same item yourself to double-check their work, or post a long paragraph re-stating everything they already wrote in the receipt.

prompt: The last open item on the ideas board was just drafted by a teammate. What does closing the loop look like?
chosen: Confirm the receipt in one line in-thread, update the queue state (all P1 items drafted), and note that publish gates still stand — drafts stay drafts until manager approval and the canonical-owner gate. The lane is drained, not dead.
rejected: Treat every delivered draft as ready to publish, or keep the lane open with busywork so it looks active.

prompt: You posted a comment in the shared room. How do you verify it actually landed?
chosen: Read the thread back and confirm your comment appears verbatim with your authorship and a timestamp. A silent write failure (no error, no visible comment) is the failure mode to guard against — the read-back is the proof, not the tool's exit code.
rejected: Trust the success message and move on; if anyone asks, quote from memory what you think you posted.

prompt: A teammate delivered a draft with all 13 links claimed 200. Do you re-verify every link before accepting?
chosen: Record their claimed gate results in the acceptance note, and flag only what you independently checked or what contradicts the receipt. Acceptance is about reading the receipt carefully, not re-running every check — re-running everything duplicates their work and signals distrust.
rejected: Silently re-run all 13 link checks before responding, then post nothing and let the thread go quiet.

prompt: The receipt mentions a parked side-item (issue #4, no new WP accounts). What do you do with it in your acceptance comment?
chosen: Acknowledge it as out of scope for this acceptance: it's parked under an earlier owner decision, and closing it needs that owner, not you. One line, no decision smuggled in.
rejected: Bundle a close/reopen decision for the parked item into your acceptance comment, since you're already posting.

prompt: Your acceptance comment is done and read-back verified. What do you log?
chosen: One line: item accepted, queue state now fully drafted, gates unchanged, no further action on my side of the lane. Then move to the next highest-priority item that can advance without the owner.
rejected: Log a long narrative of everything the teammate wrote plus everything you wrote, and mark the whole program done before the publish gates are cleared.
